business.name: Pacific Euro Motors
business.crossStreet: Under the Jose Rizal bridge, second driveway past the paint supplier. Customer parking is the row against the wall.
business.serviceArea: Seattle, Bellevue, Kirkland, Renton, Shoreline and Mercer Island. Loaner cars for anything over a day.

services.name: Scheduled maintenance
services.line: Factory intervals for BMW, Mercedes, Audi and VW, stamped in your book. Dealer schedule, independent labour rate.

services.name: Diagnostics
services.line: ISTA, ODIS and XENTRY in-house. One hour, and we tell you what the code actually means for your car.

services.name: Timing chain & guides
services.line: The N20 and N63 jobs the dealer quotes five figures for. We have done several hundred.

services.name: Suspension & air struts
services.line: Air suspension, control arms and bushings. We rebuild the compressor rather than replacing the unit where it is sound.

services.name: Pre-purchase inspection
services.line: Two hours, on a lift, with a written report and photos. Worth it on anything German and out of warranty.

services.name: Emissions & registration
services.line: Certified specialist. If it fails, the diagnostic fee comes off the repair.

cards.title: Dealer schedule, independent rate
cards.body: We stamp the service book to the factory interval with factory-spec fluids and parts. Your warranty and your resale value are unaffected.

cards.title: While it's here
cards.body: A loaner for anything over a day, booked when you book the job. Light rail is four minutes' walk if you would rather not wait.

owner.name: Anders Røed
owner.title: Owner, ASE Master
owner.note: I spent nine years at the BMW dealer on Airport Way before opening this place in 2011, and half the cars in the shop today are ones the dealer quoted and the owner wanted a second opinion on. I will give you that second opinion honestly, which sometimes means telling you the dealer was right. If the quote you are holding is for a timing chain, bring it in — I will show you on the lift what is actually worn.

reasons.title: We show you on the lift
reasons.body: You are welcome under the car with us. Most people take the photos we send instead, which is fine too.

reasons.title: Factory tooling, honest labour
reasons.body: The same diagnostic software the dealer runs, at an independent shop's hourly rate.

reasons.title: We will tell you it can wait
reasons.body: German cars generate long service lists. Plenty of the items on yours are fine for another year, and we will say which.

reviews.name: Ilse K.
reviews.text: Dealer quoted $6,800 for a timing chain. Anders put it on the lift, showed me the guide wear was nowhere near failure, and did the oil filter housing leak that was actually causing the noise for $740.

reviews.name: Devon P.
reviews.text: Pre-purchase inspection saved me from a car with a repaired frame rail nobody had disclosed. Two hours and a twenty-page report with photos. Cheapest $220 I have ever spent.

reviews.name: Marguerite A.
reviews.text: Air suspension went down on one corner. They rebuilt the compressor instead of selling me the $2,100 replacement unit and it has been level for a year and a half.

copy.headline: The second opinion on your dealer quote
copy.tagline: Independent German specialist in SODO. Factory diagnostic software, factory service intervals, and a technician who will show you the worn part on the lift before he replaces it.
copy.heroFinePrint: Loaner cars booked with the job · Light rail four minutes' walk
copy.servicesLede: Prices are for a four-cylinder in ordinary condition. Anything that needs a look before it can be quoted, we say so rather than guessing low.
copy.bookingLede: Four things and we'll call you back, usually the same day.
copy.bookingEscape: If a warning light is red or the car is overheating, don't fill this out — call
copy.bookingEscapeTail: before you drive it any further.
copy.trustNote: Independent since 2011 · 3 year / 36,000 mile warranty on parts & labour
copy.footerCredentials: ASE Master technicians · 3 year / 36,000 mile warranty

seo.description: Independent BMW, Mercedes, Audi and VW specialist in Seattle. Factory diagnostics, scheduled maintenance, timing chains and pre-purchase inspections. Call (206) 555-0119.
